name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.9.4-dev.2 (21 Nov): tank front HEAT tiers (top end 1075, mid-high 950), high-end IFV class 700 (XM30 KE 200), T-15/VN20 on the T-80U profile, top-attack ATGMs 11 damage, long-range AAM firing flash, Airborne/Rangers CQC/Mech. Riflemen MAAWS cards back, Multiplayer opens Mod Lobbies, launcher reloads back to 6 s. Includes 0.9.4-dev.1 and 0.9.3. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.48.
